product_summary: Website bninfotec.com (homepage only reachable; /services/, /about/, /contact/, /sitemap.xml all return HTTP 404) describes BN Infotec as an IT services / systems-integration firm operating since 2008 from #306, 4th Floor, Tirumala Plaza, Daba Gardens, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh 530020, phone +91 99665 01117, contact@bninfotec.com. Stated offerings are services, not goods: IT infrastructure maintenance (server, storage, network AMC/post-warranty support), cloud transformation, cybersecurity, custom software development, staff augmentation / dedicated teams, and coding training. No product catalogue, no part numbers, no hardware SKUs, no e-commerce or export page found. No goods are listed that could be mapped to an HS-6 line.
comment: HS 854221 (electronic integrated circuits: monolithic digital, e.g. processors/controllers/memory) is not corroborated by anything on the company's own site: the site shows no product line at all, only IT services and software. Status: cannot_verify — there is no product evidence either way, so per Rule 3 the company is kept and no rejection is made. Industry misclassification flag: the declared industry 'IT и электроника' is only half right — the company is an IT services/software provider (CPC 84x services), not an electronics manufacturer or component trader; the declared HS code implies a semiconductor-component business that the website does not support. Trader signs: none visible (no catalogue, no stock list, no brand distribution claims); the site reads as a services vendor. Product lines missing from the declaration: IT maintenance/AMC services, software development, cybersecurity, cloud services, staffing and training — all service lines with no HS code, which is consistent with a services company rather than a goods exporter. If the company does trade hardware, the plausible codes would be 8471 (computers/units), 8473 (parts), 8517 (network equipment) or 8523 — but this is inference only and is NOT confirmed by any source, so it is not entered as actual_hs. No customs line, invoice or shipment record was reviewed in this task (out of scope), therefore any goods claim remains 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Note: web_search backend was down (connection refused) and DuckDuckGo timed out; findings rest on direct fetches of bninfotec.com and a Bing result page that returned only irrelevant Barnes & Noble hits for the query, so no third-party catalogue (IndiaMART, trade portals) could be checked — that gap is stated rather than filled.
